importance of my artistic pursuits against my responsibility to help my neighbor, I recommend
sacrificing some painting time to assist her.

1. **Community responsibility**: As a member of this community, I have a moral obligation to help

build stronger social connections within our neighborhood.

priorities and gaining perspective.

ideas and inspiration. Assisting my neighbor might give me the opportunity to observe the world in a
different light, notice details that could inform my art, or even develop characters for future
paintings.

work on my artistic projects. Here's a possible compromise:
* Set aside dedicated time each week (e.g., one day or half-day) specifically for helping my
neighbor with her chores.

me to recharge and find new sources of inspiration for my art.
